Mission Local reported that Alemany Farm faced a $100,000–$150,000 budget gap after one-time city funding ran out. The farm paused paid apprenticeship programs, reduced staff hours and sought to raise $200,000. The story also noted that about half of the farm’s funding the prior year came from city sources, and that the Human Services Agency approved a grant extension through June 2026.

The story carries a correction: the projected budget-gap estimate came from Alemany Farm, not the San Francisco Human Services Agency.
